analytics.adminSetupTitle: What an administrator needs to do
analytics.adminSetupBody: Embedding needs a Microsoft Entra service principal and a paid Power BI capacity. Register an application in Entra ID, give it access to the Power BI workspace, then set the Power BI variables and restart the service. Until then, an analyst can connect Power BI Desktop straight to the read-only schema below.
